name: bitcoin-knots
summary: [Bitcoin Knots](https://bitcoinknots.org/) can be used as a desktop client for regular payments or as a full node server utility for merchants and other payment services.

ports.description: Bitcoin Knots desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores all data.

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

>[!WARNING]
>This container is intended to run as a full Bitcoin node for the network, using it as a wallet is dangerous unless you really know what you are doing. Even momentary accidental exposure of this container can completely compromise a stored wallet.

changelog.text: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
